codebase.title: MUDPACK 5.0.1 multigrid elliptic PDE solvers
codebase.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 over typed sorted regular-file paths+bytes and symlink paths+safe targets

agent_authored.description: MUDPACK 5.0.1 is a Fortran 77/90 library by John Adams (NCAR) of multigrid solvers for linear separable and nonseparable elliptic partial differential equations on rectangular 2D and 3D domains: real (mud2, mud3), complex (cud2, cud3) and hybrid multigrid/direct (muh2, muh3, cuh2, cuh3) solvers, second and fourth order, with cross-derivative (cr), separable (sp) and self-adjoint (sa) variants, mixed boundary conditions, and OpenMP directives on the relaxation loops. It is vendored as its own codebase from the NCAR-Classic-Libraries-for-Geophysics container repository.
evidence: README.md and OVERVIEW of the upstream container repository
doc/README_* and the HTML manual under doc/

measurement.regular_file_rule: all regular files below the source snapshot
measurement.physical_line_rule: UTF-8/NUL-free bytes: newline count plus one final non-newline line
measurement.text_binary_rule: NUL-containing or non-UTF-8 files are binary for line accounting
measurement.directory_rule: count non-root directory ancestors containing an included regular file or symlink
measurement.symlink_rule: count links without following them; external/parent targets are redacted
measurement.classification: CLI-owned rules plus explicitly agent-authored source/test classification

breakdown.rule: approximate: a text file is third-party when under measurement.third_party_paths, else a test when under a test path marker or named test_*, else an example when under an example path marker, else production when its extension is in measurement.source_extensions, else other

approval.human_ref: single-module default: the whole codebase is one module; no human decision at STOP 1, the cut is read in the source PR body at STOP 2

build.system: make (GNU make; one top-level Makefile per library, each including a make.inc that selects the compiler by `uname -s`; src/ builds a static library, test/ compiles and immediately runs every test program)
commands: make MAKE=make AR=ar F90="gfortran -fdefault-real-8 -O2 -std=legacy -J LIBDIR -I LIBDIR" CPP="gfortran -cpp -E"   (double precision, the darwin.dp reference build)
make MAKE=make AR=ar F90="gfortran -O2 -std=legacy -J LIBDIR -I LIBDIR" CPP="gfortran -cpp -E"   (single precision, the darwin.sp reference build)
pitfalls: make.inc chooses the compiler from `uname -s`: on Linux it wants pgf90 or g95, on Darwin gfortran but MAKE := the hard-coded gmake path, which does not exist on current macOS; override MAKE=make AR=ar F90=... on the make command line (all five libraries)

gfortran 15.2 (and every gfortran >= 10) refuses the Fortran 77 argument-type and rank mismatches in FFTPACK, FISHPACK and SPHEREPACK ("Type mismatch between actual argument ... REAL(8) vs COMPLEX(8)", "Rank mismatch in argument theta") unless -std=legacy (or -fallow-argument-mismatch) is given; measured: fftpack 12 errors, spherepack 2 errors without it

the shipped darwin.dp transcripts were produced with -fdefault-real-8; the libraries are written for single precision and the darwin.sp build reproduces fewer digits (FISHPACK 1 to 4 digits, MUDPACK 0 to 2) and mudpack tcud3cr does not converge in single precision (ierror -10 here, ierror -4 and NaN in the shipped darwin.sp)
wall_s is the double-precision `make` run, which includes the 36 test runs the test Makefile executes (under 2 s in total); the single-precision build took the same

landscape.notes: one driver per solver (mud/cud x d/h x 2/3 x 2nd/4th order x cr/sp/sa variants); output/darwin.dp and darwin.sp; OpenMP directives (515 lines in 53 source files) are inactive without -fopenmp

pitfalls.symptom: make: pgf90/g95 not found (Linux) or the hard-coded gmake path not found (macOS)
pitfalls.workaround: make MAKE=make AR=ar F90="gfortran -fdefault-real-8 -O2 -std=legacy -J LIBDIR -I LIBDIR" CPP="gfortran -cpp -E"

pitfalls.symptom: gfortran >= 10: Error: Type mismatch between actual argument ... (REAL(8) vs COMPLEX(8)); Error: Rank mismatch in argument theta
single-precision (default) build gives 0 to 4 matching digits and mudpack tcud3cr fails to converge
pitfalls.workaround: build with -fdefault-real-8 as the shipped darwin.dp references were

pitfalls.symptom: every test program writes only to stdout; the test Makefile pattern rule runs each executable right after linking it (the pattern rule executes the program it just linked), so `make` in test/ is build plus run and output/darwin.dp is the whole transcript
pitfalls.workaround: run the .exe files again by hand to capture per-test stdout

not_run.why: the OpenMP directives are opt-in; all 36 drivers ran serially, the thread-parallel build was not attempted in Step 1.2

build_and_run.classification: CLI-copied from the Step 1.2 record (runs.json); agent-measured on the native build

modules.title: MUDPACK 5.0.1 multigrid elliptic PDE solvers
entrypoints: test/t*.f drivers, one per solver: mud2/mud3 (real), cud2/cud3 (complex), muh2/muh3 and cuh2/cuh3 (hybrid), 2nd and 4th order (mud24 etc.), cr, sp and sa variants
modules.expensive_path: multigrid V and W cycles: line and point Gauss-Seidel relaxation, restriction and prolongation over the grid hierarchy (mudcom.f) on 2D and 3D grids; the OpenMP directives target these loops
modules.rationale: The whole library is one module: one build (make, one static library), one test set, one scientific responsibility. MUDPACK 5.0.1 (Adams, NCAR) solves separable and nonseparable linear elliptic PDEs in 2D and 3D by multigrid iteration: real and complex, second- and fourth-order, with hybrid multigrid/direct variants, cross-derivative, separable and self-adjoint forms, and OpenMP directives on the relaxation loops. It is vendored from the NCAR-Classic-Libraries-for-Geophysics container repository as its own codebase because the container holds five unrelated libraries that share no source; this one is packaged alone.
hazards: OpenMP is opt-in (-fopenmp); a threaded build may change reduction order
single precision by default; tcud3cr fails to converge in single precision, so the double-precision build is the reference
Fortran 90 extensions in a Fortran 77 body
modules.purpose: The whole library is one module: one build (make, one static library), one test set, one scientific responsibility. MUDPACK 5.0.1 (Adams, NCAR) solves separable and nonseparable linear elliptic PDEs in 2D and 3D by multigrid iteration: real and complex, second- and fourth-order, with hybrid multigrid/direct variants, cross-derivative, separable and self-adjoint forms, and OpenMP directives on the relaxation loops. It is vendored from the NCAR-Classic-Libraries-for-Geophysics container repository as its own codebase because the container holds five unrelated libraries that share no source; this one is packaged alone.
primary_inputs: integer and floating-point parameter arrays (domain, boundary-condition codes, grid sizes as p*2^(e-1)+1, cycle controls, tolerance), user coefficient and boundary subroutines, the right-hand side, a work array, an initial guess
primary_outputs: the approximate solution on the fine grid, the number of cycles and the relative difference profile, an integer error flag
algorithm_stages: discretisation of the coefficient operator on every grid level (dis* routines per solver)
multigrid cycling (V, W or full multigrid) with line or point relaxation, restriction and prolongation (mudcom.f and mud3ln.f)
optional fourth-order deferred-correction pass (mud24 etc.) and hybrid direct solves on the coarsest grid (muh/cuh)
unique_responsibilities: iterative solution of nonseparable elliptic PDEs in 2D and 3D
not_responsible_for: direct separable solvers (FISHPACK) and spherical-harmonic operators (SPHEREPACK)
evidence: src/ (the library), test/ (the drivers), Makefile and make.inc
runs.json: every driver built and run natively
modules.classification: agent-authored module card; CLI-computed size and approval status
